problem: University students struggle to find compatible peers for collaborative study sessions, leading to inefficient learning and missed networking opportunities.
target_user: University students seeking to form study groups with peers sharing the same courses, compatible schedules, and preferred study styles.
goals: Allow students to create and edit personal study profiles
Automatically match students based on course enrollment, availability, and study style
Enable students to view and join suggested study groups
Provide in‑app scheduling tools for group sessions
Facilitate group communication via chat and notifications
Allow group owners to manage members and session details
non_goals: Integrating paid third‑party calendar or messaging services
Offering video conferencing beyond basic browser‑based chat
requirements: User authentication via university SSO or email/password
Profile fields: courses, weekly availability slots, study style (silent, discussion, mixed)
Matching algorithm that respects constraints and prioritizes high compatibility
Group dashboard showing members, upcoming sessions, and chat thread
In‑app calendar view for scheduling sessions
Email notifications for group invitations and session reminders
Data stored securely in a relational database
No reliance on paid external APIs
Deployable on standard cloud VM or container platform

user_stories.i_want: to register and create a study profile with my courses, availability, and preferred study style
user_stories.so_that: others can find me for suitable study groups
acceptance_criteria: Registration succeeds with email verification or SSO
Profile page allows adding, editing, and removing courses
Availability can be entered as recurring weekly time blocks
Study style options are selectable and saved
Profile data persists across sessions

user_stories.i_want: to receive a list of recommended study groups that match my profile
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly join groups that fit my needs
acceptance_criteria: Matching runs after profile completion
Recommendations show at least 3 groups with compatibility score
Each recommendation displays course, meeting times, and study style
Student can click to view group details or request to join

user_stories.i_want: to create a new study group for a specific course and set preferred meeting times and style
user_stories.so_that: I can attract peers with similar preferences
acceptance_criteria: Group creation form requires course selection, time slots, and study style
Group receives a unique shareable link or code
Creator becomes group owner with management rights

user_stories.i_want: to manage group membership requests and remove members if needed
user_stories.so_that: the group stays focused and productive
acceptance_criteria: Owner sees pending join requests with student profiles
Owner can approve or reject requests with a single click
Owner can remove existing members and the system notifies them

user_stories.i_want: to view upcoming study sessions on a calendar and receive reminders
acceptance_criteria: Calendar displays all confirmed session times for the group
Email and in‑app notifications are sent 24 hours and 1 hour before each session

user_stories.i_want: to chat with other members within the app
user_stories.so_that: we can coordinate and discuss topics before or after sessions
acceptance_criteria: Chat window is accessible from the group dashboard
Messages are persisted for the duration of the group
Basic markdown formatting is supported

user_stories.i_want: to receive email notifications for group invitations and session changes
user_stories.so_that: I stay informed even when not logged in
acceptance_criteria: Invitation email contains group name, course, and join link
Session change email includes updated time and reason
All core functionalities (registration, profile, matching, group creation, calendar, chat, notifications) work on modern browsers
System handles at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation
No paid third‑party services are used; all APIs are free or self‑hosted
Data privacy complies with university policy (no data sold or exposed)
The application can be deployed within a five‑week sprint using a four‑person team

risks.description: Matching algorithm may be too simplistic, leading to low-quality recommendations
Limited development time (5 weeks) may cause incomplete features
Reliance on email delivery without paid services could result in deliverability issues
User adoption may be low if onboarding is not intuitive
Data security breaches if database is misconfigured
